strings.{actor} 被推出了道班房，一个人走进了雨里。: {actor} is pushed out of the hut and walks off into the rain alone.
strings.一场塌方，一辆大巴，一间漏雨的道班房。熬到天亮就好。: A landslide, a bus, a leaky roadside hut. Just make it to morning.
strings.一块石头砸在车顶上，{actor} 吓得从车门台阶上摔了下来: A rock bangs onto the bus roof and {actor} falls off the door steps in fright
strings.一架无人机顺着公路飞了上来。它看见了路口的 SOS，在道班房上空转了两圈，扔下一: A drone comes flying up along the road. It spots the SOS at the bend, circles the hut twice and drops a parcel: hardtack, a few bottles of water, a first-aid kit, and a laminated note — “We know you're here. The road will be open after daybreak. Stay put.”
strings.一袋别人落下的面包和火腿肠: A bag of bread and sausages someone left behind
strings.一间废弃多年的道班房：一间屋子，一个铁炉子，铁皮屋顶漏雨。门前就是公路，五十米外: A road-maintenance hut, abandoned for years: one room, an iron stove, a tin roof that leaks. The road runs past the door; the bus stands fifty metres away, and beyond it the landslide.
strings.下山的时候，王伯在塌方旁边站了很久。后来他托人在那个弯道边立了一块小石碑，上面没: On the way down, Uncle Walt stands by the landslide for a long time. Later he has a small stone set up at that bend. There is no name on it, only a date.
strings.不能就这么干等着：要么走出去，要么去前面探路: No sitting around waiting: either walk out, or go and scout the road
strings.不让年轻人冒险走夜路: Keep the young ones from walking the road at night
strings.两个人去看看路还能不能走，顺便在路口做个记号；其他人留下: Two of them check whether the road ahead is passable and mark the bend; the rest stay
strings.中午，路通了。抢修队把大家接下了山：{survivors}。: At noon the road opens. The road crew bring everyone down the mountain: {survivors}.
strings.云南口音，常说“莫慌”“整得好”“听我的”。: Yunnan accent; always saying “Don't panic”, “That'll do” and “Listen to me”.
strings.云散了，对面山上的塌方看得清清楚楚。: The clouds part. The landslide on the slope opposite is plain to see.
strings.互相搀着，慢慢走: Hold on to each other and go slowly
strings.你包里还有一盒月饼（六个），是带给科室同事的。你还没跟任何人说。: There's a box of mooncakes (six) in your bag, a present for the people on your ward. You haven't told anyone.
strings.你年轻时有个工友，就是在雨夜里走这条路，被垮山埋了的。你从没跟人提过。: When you were young, a workmate of yours walked this road on a rainy night and was buried by a slide. You have never told anyone.
strings.你的包里还藏着两包饼干和一瓶水，是给小宇留的。你不打算拿出来。: Your bag still hides two packs of biscuits and a bottle of water, kept for Danny. You don't plan to bring them out.
strings.做事认真，有点怕生，不太会拒绝别人。可一看到有人受伤，她会马上镇定下来。: Conscientious, a little shy, bad at saying no. But the moment someone is hurt, she goes completely calm.
strings.傍晚又清点了一遍，吃的少了一些，墙缝里塞着两张撕开的包装纸。有人说夜里有人偷吃，: At dusk the supplies are counted again and some food is missing. Two torn wrappers are stuffed into a crack in the wall. Someone says a person must have been eating on the sly; Uncle Walt says this hut has always had rats.
strings.先拿来分了，出去以后再说: Share it out now and settle up later
strings.公平，苏姐也不亏: Fair, and Sue doesn't lose out
strings.出发前你收到了交通部门的暴雨预警短信，建议这条路暂停通行。你想着天黑前能赶到县城: Before setting off you got a rainstorm warning text from the traffic authority advising against this road. You thought you'd make the county town before dark and drove up anyway.
strings.去山坡上的林子里捡还能烧的枯枝。下雨天柴是湿的，捡得少，人也会淋湿。铁炉子每 1: Gather dead branches that will still burn from the woods on the slope. In the rain the wood is wet, you find less, and you get soaked. The iron stove burns 1 unit of wood every 12 hours.
strings.去路口立三角牌，在路面上用石头摆 SOS，天黑以后打手电。抢修队越早知道这里有人: Put up the warning triangle at the bend, lay out SOS in stones on the road, and wave a torch after dark. The sooner the road crew knows someone is here, the better.
strings.县医院的实习护士，放完假回去上班。背着一个双肩包，里面有一个小急救包。: A trainee nurse at the county hospital, on her way back to work after the holiday. She carries a backpack with a small first-aid kit in it.
strings.司机座位后面还挂着一个急救包: A first-aid kit still hanging behind the driver's seat
strings.回到医院以后，林小满报名参加了野外急救培训。她说那一夜让她明白，医院外面的急救是: Back at the hospital, Mandy Lin signs up for a wilderness first-aid course. That night taught her, she says, that first aid outside a hospital is another thing entirely.
strings.回到镇上，苏姐把剩下的方便面摆回了货架，标价一分没改。: Back in town, Sue puts the leftover instant noodles back on the shelf, at exactly the same price.
strings.国庆长假的最后一天，一辆开往县城的大巴在盘山公路上被塌方堵住了。前面的路埋在泥石: On the last day of the National Day holiday, a bus bound for the county town is stopped by a landslide on a winding mountain road. The road ahead lies buried in mud and rock, and stones keep falling on the road behind. The driver, Joe, takes the passengers who are left — four adults and a child — into an abandoned road-maintenance hut by the road.
strings.在昆明读大三，放假回家，明天上午有一门补考。从上车起就一直在看手机上的时间。: A third-year student in Kunming heading back from the holiday, with a resit exam tomorrow morning. He's been checking the time on his phone ever since he got on the bus.
strings.在镇上开小卖部，这次去州里进货，带着外甥小宇。她的两个大纸箱，一箱方便面、一箱矿: Runs a little shop in town and went to the prefecture capital to restock, bringing her nephew Danny. Her two big cartons — one of instant noodles, one of bottled water — have come into the hut too.
strings.多半是老鼠，把吃的吊到房梁上: Probably rats — hang the food from the rafters
strings.大嗓门，爱说“亲兄弟明算账”“我又不是开善堂的”。: Loud; always saying “Even brothers keep accounts” and “I'm not running a charity”.
strings.大家一起连夜走下山: Everyone walks down the mountain tonight
strings.大家互相搀着，踩着泥一步一步走了下去。: Holding on to each other, everyone picks their way down through the mud.
strings.大家你看我、我看你，谁也不承认。屋里的气氛一下子冷了下来。: Everyone looks at everyone else; nobody owns up. The room goes cold.
strings.大家凑钱，按进价买下来分: Everyone chips in and buys them at cost
strings.大家打着手电走了两个多小时。在一个弯道上，前面一整段路都滑进了沟里。只好浑身湿透: Everyone walks for over two hours by torchlight. At a bend, the whole road ahead has slid into the gully. Soaked to the skin, they feel their way back to the hut in the dark.
strings.大家拧干湿衣服，挤进了道班房。老周从车上拆了几块座椅垫子，铺在地上。: Everyone wrings out their wet clothes and crowds into the hut. Joe pulls a few seat cushions out of the bus and lays them on the floor.
strings.大家说好，今晚轮流守着吃的，困了就叫醒下一个。: They agree to take turns watching the food tonight, waking the next person when they get sleepy.
strings.大家都能吃饱，可苏姐会觉得东西是被抢走的: Everyone eats their fill, but Sue will feel robbed
strings.大巴就停在五十米外，行李舱和座位底下可能还有能用的东西。山上偶尔还在掉石头，别待: The bus is only fifty metres away; there may still be something useful in the luggage hold or under the seats. Stones still fall from the slope now and then — don't stay long.
strings.大巴被塌方堵在半山腰。天快黑了，雨越下越大。阿杰说县城只有 14 公里，打着手电: The bus is stuck halfway up the mountain behind a landslide. It's nearly dark and the rain is getting heavier. Jake says the county town is only 14 km away — a night's walk by torchlight. Uncle Walt shakes his head: walking a mountain road on a rainy night is asking to die. What do you do?
strings.大巴车厢和行李舱: The bus and its luggage hold
strings.天亮了。山下传来挖掘机的声音：养护站的抢修队打通了道路，正在清最后一段塌方。一个: Daybreak. The sound of an excavator comes up from below: the road crew has opened the road and is clearing the last stretch of the slide. A worker in an orange vest waves hard at the hut.
strings.天快黑了，雨还在下。离县城还有 14 公里，手机没有信号。养护站的抢修队最快明天: It's nearly dark and still raining. The county town is 14 km away and there's no phone signal. The road crew can't open the road before tomorrow at the earliest.
strings.尊重苏姐，可今天大家多半要饿着肚子: Respects Sue, but everyone will probably go hungry today
strings.小声说话，爱问“还要多久”。: Speaks softly; keeps asking “How much longer?”
strings.小宇手臂上的伤口后来只留下一道浅浅的疤。林小满回到医院，带教老师看了她做的包扎，: The cut on Danny's arm leaves only a faint scar. Back at the hospital, Mandy Lin's supervisor looks at a dressing she did and says, “Good.” She remembers that one word for a long time.
strings.小宇没能等到天亮。: Danny doesn't make it to morning.
strings.小宇的伤口感染了，在县医院打了一个星期的点滴。出院那天，他问护士：“那个姐姐也在: Danny's wound gets infected and he spends a week on a drip at the county hospital. The day he's discharged he asks a nurse, “Does that other nurse work here too?”
strings.小宇的伤口长好了。开学以后，他在作文里写：“我在山上的一间小房子里住了一晚，有个: Danny's wound heals. When school starts he writes in an essay: “I spent a night in a little house on the mountain, and a nurse bandaged my arm.”
strings.小满姐姐，我的手不疼了。: My arm doesn't hurt anymore, Mandy.
strings.年轻时在这条路上当了三十年道班工人，这间道班房他住过。这次是去县城看孙子。: Worked this road as a road-maintenance man for thirty years and once lived in this very hut. He's on his way to the county town to see his grandson.
strings.座位底下滚着几瓶矿泉水: A few bottles of water rolling around under the seats
strings.开放的伤口不处理会感染。「照顾伤员」会用掉急救用品，医疗技能越高，处理得越好。: An open wound that isn't treated gets infected. “Care for the injured” uses up first-aid supplies; the better the medical skill, the better the treatment.
strings.开这条山路开了十一年的大巴司机，熟悉路况，也认识养护站的人。: A bus driver who has driven this mountain road for eleven years. He knows the road, and the people at the maintenance station.
strings.急躁，坐不住，觉得干等就是浪费时间。心不坏，就是一着急说话就冲。: Impatient, can't sit still, thinks waiting is a waste of time. Means well, but when he's in a hurry he speaks too bluntly.
strings.成年人一天大约要 2000–2500 千卡、2–3 升水。饿一两天不会有大碍，缺: An adult needs roughly 2,000–2,500 kcal and 2–3 L of water a day. A day or two of going hungry does little harm; running short of water saps strength much faster.
strings.我妈会不会担心我？: Will my mum be worried about me?
strings.所有人都活着下了山，可有人是一个人走下去的。坐在面包车里，大家都没有提那天夜里的: Everyone made it down the mountain alive, but someone walked down alone. In the minibus, nobody mentions that night.
strings.把脸盆、水桶摆到屋檐下，再用塑料布引水。雨越大接得越多，不下雨就接不到。接雨的人: Set basins and buckets under the eaves and run plastic sheeting to channel the water. The harder it rains the more you get; no rain, no water. Whoever does it gets soaked.
strings.把车上的每一个人都平安送下山: Get every passenger safely down the mountain
strings.抢修队把活着的人接下了山：{survivors}。没能等到天亮的：{dead}。: The road crew bring the living down the mountain: {survivors}. Those who didn't make it to morning: {dead}. The hut was later torn down; in its place stands a sign: Take care on rainy days.
strings.抢修队的人带着雨衣和一壶热水上来了。: The road crew come up with raincoats and a flask of hot water.
strings.抢修队的工人给每个人递了一杯热水。{aliveCount} 个人一个不少，坐上了: A road worker hands everyone a cup of hot water. All {aliveCount} of them climb into the minibus that came to fetch them. As it passes the landslide, nobody says a word. Later they start a group chat called “The Hut”.
strings.挨个问清楚，非把这个人找出来不可: Question everyone until the culprit is found
strings.收拾东西，下去和他们会合: Pack up and go down to meet them
strings.早上清点吃的：大家包里凑出来的饼干和面包，省着吃也撑不过今天。苏姐的两个纸箱里有: Counting the food in the morning: the biscuits and bread from everyone's bags won't last the day, even sparingly. Sue's two cartons hold a case of instant noodles and a case of bottled water — stock for her shop.
strings.普通话，语速快，爱说“不是吧”“那还等什么”“我去就我去”。: Standard Mandarin, fast talker; always saying “No way”, “What are we waiting for” and “Fine, I'll go”.
strings.最稳妥。不过今晚得弄到柴和水，屋顶还在漏: The safest choice. But tonight you'll need wood and water, and the roof still leaks
strings.林小满一个人走进了雨里。后来有人说在下一个村子见过她，也有人说没有。: Mandy Lin walks off into the rain alone. Later someone says they saw her in the next village; someone else says they didn't.
strings.林小满后来很少说起那一夜。: Mandy Lin rarely talks about that night afterwards.
strings.林小满没能走出那间道班房。她的双肩包里，那盒月饼还在。: Mandy Lin never made it out of that hut. The box of mooncakes is still in her backpack.
strings.根据西南山区雨季常见的公路塌方改编：大巴被堵在半山腰，乘客在路边过夜，第二天由公: Based on the road landslides common in the mountains of southwest China in the rainy season: a bus is trapped halfway up a mountain, the passengers spend the night by the road, and road-maintenance workers open the road the next day. Not one particular event — a short game for first-time players.
strings.没有人等到天亮。抢修队推开道班房的门时，炉子早就凉了。: Nobody makes it to morning. When the road crew pushes open the door of the hut, the stove has long gone cold.
strings.滇西北某县道 K37 处（虚构）: Km 37 of a county road in northwest Yunnan (fictional)
strings.照顾好小宇，别让他的伤口感染: Look after Danny and keep his wound from getting infected
strings.王伯到了县城，抱着孙子说：“爷爷在山上的老房子里住了一晚。”孙子问冷不冷，他说：: In the county town, Uncle Walt hugs his grandson: “Grandpa spent a night in the old house up on the mountain.” His grandson asks if it was cold. “There was a stove. It wasn't cold.”
strings.王伯后来跟孙子讲那天晚上的事，讲到年轻人打着手电往外走，他就不往下讲了。: When Uncle Walt tells his grandson about that night, he gets as far as the young people heading out with their torches, and stops there.
strings.王伯死在了他住过的道班房里。抢修队里有个老工人认出了他，摘下了安全帽。: Uncle Walt died in the hut he once lived in. An old worker on the road crew recognized him and took off his hard hat.
strings.王伯被赶出了这间他住过十几年的屋子。他在屋檐下坐了一夜，听雨打在铁皮上。: Uncle Walt was thrown out of the room he lived in for over ten years. He sat under the eaves all night, listening to the rain on the tin.
strings.王伯说他住在这里的时候就闹老鼠。大家把吃的装进塑料袋，吊到了房梁上。: Uncle Walt says the place had rats even when he lived here. They put the food in plastic bags and hang it from the rafters.
strings.王伯还住在县城，每年雨季都会给养护站打个电话。: Uncle Walt still lives in the county town, and every rainy season he gives the maintenance station a call.
strings.王爷爷，你以前真的住在这里吗？: Grandpa Walt, did you really live here?
strings.留在道班房过夜，等天亮: Stay in the hut tonight and wait for morning
strings.秋雨里气温 6–13°C。在户外干活的人会被淋湿，湿衣服让体感低 6°C；回到屋: Autumn rain, 6–13°C. Whoever works outdoors gets wet, and wet clothes make it feel 6°C colder; it takes the lit stove indoors to dry them out slowly.
strings.等他们上来接: Wait for them to come up
strings.精明，会算账，嘴硬心软。辛辛苦苦挣的钱，不愿意让人白拿；可看见孩子饿着，她自己先: Shrewd, good with figures, sharp-tongued but soft-hearted. She won't let anyone take her hard-earned goods for nothing — but she can't bear to see a child go hungry.
strings.纸箱被直接撕开了。苏姐骂了几句，没人接话。她搂着小宇，坐到了墙角。: The cartons are torn open. Sue curses; nobody answers. She takes Danny and sits in the corner.
strings.老周后来不开长途了，在县城开公交。有人问他为什么，他说：“开慢点，好。”: Joe stops driving long-distance and drives a city bus in the county town. Asked why, he says, “Slower is good.”
strings.老周把大巴开回车站，交了钥匙，在车站门口抽了半包烟。那条预警短信他一直没删。第二: Joe drives the bus back to the depot, hands in the keys and smokes half a pack outside the gate. He never deletes that warning text. The next year he takes an emergency rescuer's certificate on his own.
strings.老周没能把车上的人送到县城。抢修队的人说，他是这条线上开得最稳的司机。: Joe never got his passengers to the county town. The road crew say he was the steadiest driver on the line.
strings.老周被赶出道班房后，一个人在大巴的驾驶座上坐了一夜，双闪一直开着。: Thrown out of the hut, Joe spends the night alone in the driver's seat, hazard lights blinking.
strings.胆子小，懂事，疼了也不怎么哭。: Timid and sensible; doesn't cry much even when it hurts.
strings.苏姐到最后也没拿到那箱方便面的钱。她逢人就讲那天的事，讲着讲着又加一句：“不过那: Sue never gets paid for that case of noodles. She tells everyone the story, and always ends with: “Still, the boy ate his fill.”
strings.苏姐掏出小本子，一笔一笔记下谁出了多少钱。纸箱拆开了，屋里第一次有了笑声。: Sue takes out a notebook and writes down who paid what. The cartons are opened, and for the first time there's laughter in the hut.
strings.苏姐没能回到镇上。小卖部的卷帘门，后来是小宇的妈妈拉开的。: Sue never made it back to town. Her shop's shutter was eventually raised by Danny's mother.
strings.苏姐犹豫了半天，拆了一包方便面泡给小宇，又拿出几瓶水：“剩下的，等出去了再说。”: Sue hesitates a long time, then cooks a packet of noodles for Danny and hands out a few bottles of water: “The rest can wait till we're out.”
strings.苏姐的外甥，九岁，上三年级。塌方的时候车窗玻璃碎了，划伤了他的左小臂。: Sue's nephew, nine years old, in third grade. When the slide hit, a bus window shattered and cut his left forearm.
strings.苏姐的小本子上记着每个人出了多少钱。回到镇上，她把那一页撕下来，贴在了小卖部的收: Sue's notebook records what everyone paid. Back in town she tears out the page and sticks it up beside the till.
strings.苏姐被赶出了道班房。她在大巴上坐了一夜，隔着车窗看着道班房里的火光。: Sue is thrown out of the hut. She sits in the bus all night, watching the firelight in the hut through the window.
strings.行李舱里有几块垫货的旧木板，劈开能烧: A few old boards from the luggage hold — split, they'll burn
strings.让阿杰和老周先去前面探探路: Send Jake and Joe ahead to scout the road
strings.话不多，慢性子，凡事看天。对山和雨有一种近乎迷信的敬畏，从来不跟山较劲。: A man of few words, slow and patient, takes things as the weather comes. He has an almost superstitious respect for mountains and rain, and never picks a fight with either.
strings.说出来痛快，可是没有证据，谁都会觉得被怀疑了: Feels good to say it, but there's no proof — and everyone will feel suspected
strings.说话慢，爱讲“我们那时候……”，管塌方叫“垮山”。: Speaks slowly, loves to start with “Back in our day…”, and calls a landslide “the mountain coming down”.
strings.说话轻，爱用“要不……”“我看看”开头。: Speaks softly; often starts with “Maybe we could…” or “Let me see”.
strings.责任心重，习惯替所有人拿主意。嘴上说“莫慌”，心里一直在自责。: Feels responsible for everything and is used to deciding for everyone. Says “Don't panic” out loud while blaming himself inside.
strings.货不能白给人拿；小宇要平平安安: Nobody takes her goods for free; Danny stays safe
strings.路口的三角牌、路面上用石头摆的 SOS、晚上的手电。下雨会冲掉一些。外面的人越早: The warning triangle at the bend, SOS laid out in stones on the road, a torch at night. Rain washes some of it away. The sooner the outside world knows someone is here, the better.
strings.路还滑，等他们把路清干净: The road is still slippery; wait until they've cleared it
strings.运气好，明早就到县城；可雨夜里，路随时会再塌: With luck you reach the county town by morning; but on a rainy night the road could slide again at any moment
strings.这是新手教程：一局只有一天半，危险不大。屏幕上会一步一步告诉你怎么玩。: This is the tutorial: one game lasts a day and a half and isn't very dangerous. The screen will show you how to play, step by step.
strings.这门课你已经挂了两次，补考再不过就要退学。家里人还不知道。: You've failed this course twice; fail the resit and you'll be expelled. Your family doesn't know.
strings.那是她的货，让她自己决定: They're her goods — let her decide
strings.那盒月饼最后是在道班房里分掉的，一人一块。林小满跟科室同事说起这件事，大家笑着问: In the end the mooncakes were shared out in the hut, one each. When Mandy Lin tells the people on her ward, they laugh: “So where are the mooncakes?” “They came in handy up on the mountain.”
strings.铁皮屋顶有几处在漏雨，屋里的人睡不干。爬上去用塑料布和石头压住。下雨天屋顶很滑。: The tin roof leaks in several places and nobody inside can sleep dry. Climb up and weigh plastic sheeting down with stones. The roof is slippery in the rain.
strings.阿杰后来再也不坐夜班车了。: Jake never takes a night bus again.
strings.阿杰后来总跟同学讲那天晚上的事：“我们打着手电往前走，前面的路整个滑下去了。”讲: Jake keeps telling his classmates about that night: “We were walking by torchlight and the whole road ahead had just slid away.” He always pauses there.
strings.阿杰和老周去了一个多小时，回来时浑身是泥：前面两公里也塌了，走不通。不过他们在塌: Jake and Joe are gone for over an hour and come back covered in mud: the road is down for two kilometres ahead too — no way through. But they've put warning triangles at both ends of the slide.
strings.阿杰没能赶上那场补考。: Jake never made it to that resit.
strings.阿杰被赶出道班房后，一个人打着手电往山下走了。第二天，抢修队在下面的村子里找到了: Thrown out of the hut, Jake heads down the mountain alone by torchlight. The next day the road crew finds him in the village below, sitting outside a little shop, covered in mud.
strings.阿杰赶上了下午的补考，迟到了二十分钟，考完才发现鞋里全是泥。成绩出来，六十一分。: Jake makes the afternoon resit twenty minutes late and only notices afterwards that his shoes are full of mud. The result: 61.
strings.阿杰错过了补考。他给辅导员打电话讲了塌方的事，学校给了他一次缓考的机会。这一次，: Jake misses the resit. He calls his advisor and explains about the landslide, and the university lets him defer. This time he starts revising a month early.
strings.雨停了，山谷里全是雾。: The rain has stopped; the valley is full of mist.
strings.雨砸在铁皮屋顶上，说话得喊。山上不时有石头滚下来。: Rain hammers on the tin roof; you have to shout to be heard. Now and then a stone rolls down the slope.
strings.预警短信的事传开了，老周被停了三个月的班。复工那天，他把手机设成了预警必响。车上: Word of the warning text gets out and Joe is suspended for three months. On his first day back, he sets his phone to always ring for warnings. A passenger recognizes him: “Aren't you the one who…” He nods. “Yes. That was me.”
strings.（把半块饼干塞给旁边的人）我不饿。: (Pushes half a biscuit into the hand of whoever is next to him) I'm not hungry.
strings.分工时选「守夜看物资」的人，夜里能抓到偷吃的人: Whoever picks “Guard the supplies” when the work is handed out can catch a food thief in the night
